summary.intent: Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by tracing the failure through the load test workload and API controller, then fix the root causes.
summary.outcome: Added missing PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint (setByoStatus was a dead service method), fixed the load test's ipns-publish call to use proper signed records via createAndPublishIpnsRecord, fixed createByoClientPool to enable BYO mode on test accounts, and fixed pre-existing TypeScript errors across 9 API test files.

repo: setByoStatus() existed as a VaultService method but had no controller endpoint and was never called — BYO mode could not be toggled via the API at all, making register-cid always return 403 rather than the 400 noted in the todo

The byo-file-workload ipns-publish step was sending { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — the signed IPNS record must come from createAndPublishIpnsRecord
API test files consistently used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> with module.get() which loses mock method types — all specs should use mock objects directly instead of re-fetching from the module
apps/api/openapi.json is NOT the canonical spec location — the real one is packages/api-client/openapi.json; a manual node -e script wrote to the wrong path
The streaming-crypto.service.ts in the web app and sdk/client.ts both maintained independent copies of the streaming MIME type list — now centralized in sdk-core/encryption-mode.ts
SDK test files that mock @cipherbox/sdk-core with a bare factory function replace the entire module, dropping any new exports — must use importOriginal + spread pattern

code.finding: New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added here — previously setByoStatus was unreachable
ipns-publish call sent wrong fields; replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core
New centralized module for STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD, selectEncryptionMode, and normalizeEncryptionMode — imported by both sdk/client.ts and streaming-crypto.service.ts
Added optional encryptionMode param; when CTR uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv instead of GCM
Now calls selectEncryptionMode() before sdkCore.uploadFile() to determine CTR vs GCM based on MIME type and size
Removed test.skip from CTR encrypted badge test — now passes with the SDK fix in place

workflow: When the todo says '400 error' but the code shows a guard check that would return 403 first, trust the code — the todo description may be inaccurate about the specific error code
Running api:generate requires the API server to be running; manual orval invocation against a built spec is more reliable in dev
After centralizing shared logic, always grep for all existing copies to ensure none are missed (FLAC was missing from both copies before centralization)
Pre-existing TypeScript errors in spec files should be fixed proactively when touching those areas — they accumulate quickly and mask real errors

friction: Accidental openapi.json written to apps/api/ instead of packages/api-client/ by a manual node -e script — caused a spurious 3889-line file addition in the PR
GraphQL API for fetching review threads timed out repeatedly; had to fall back to REST for PR comment fetching
api:generate script ran a lint step on unrelated Rust files which failed, blocking the normal generation flow
The todo listed '400 errors' but the actual first failure was a 403 from the BYO guard check — required tracing the full request path to find the real root cause
9 API test files had the same jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> anti-pattern causing TypeScript errors — fixing them required reading each file individually
open_items: The todo for 'SDK uploadFile hardcodes GCM' landed with both a pending/ and done/ copy in main due to the merge from fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 — the stale pending copy was removed but worth verifying git history is clean
integration.test.ts in the SDK package hits a live API and fails in CI — pre-existing issue not addressed in this session
The web app Settings UI path for BYO mode — now that the endpoint exists, the UI should be wired to call PATCH /vault/byo-status
BYO load test baselines on staging (todo #11) still pending — the fix in this session unblocks it but the actual baseline run hasn't been done
